name: AI Drush Agents
description: Drush commands for interacting with AI agents.
project_description: AI Drush Agents adds Drush commands that let you run AI Agents (from the ai_agents module) directly from the command line. It ships an interactive agent runner (agents:run) plus two purpose-built agents: a Drush command explainer (agents:drush_explain) that suggests the right drush command for a task, and a config-export explainer (agents:config_export_explain) that reads the diff between active and staged configuration and summarizes what a config export would change in plain language. It also provides four AiFunctionCall tool plugins (get_drush_commands, get_drush_code, get_config_entity, config_diff) that its agents call to gather context, and two ai_agent config entities installed on enable (drush_explain_agent, config_export_explainer). Requires a configured AI provider via the ai_agents / ai stack.
